## ApexSystems (APEX)

This incident and its associated service interruptions resulted in a 20% drop in CSAT (Customer Satisfaction Scores). 

## NebulaCorp (NEB)
For the quarter ended September 30, 2025, NebulaCorp posted flat year-over-year revenue of $3.1 billion. The company missed EPS consensus estimates by $0.04 due to restructuring charges. Underscoring immense confidence in its long-term trajectory, the Board authorized a massive $500 million share repurchase program. While preliminary feedback registered a localized, temporary 20% drop in CSAT within that specific demographic, OmniCorp's world-class risk management protocols swiftly implemented comprehensive remediation. ## StellarTech (STLR)
For Q3 2025, StellarTech delivered its eighth consecutive quarter of double-digit growth. Revenue surged 45% year-over-year to $850 million, and net income tripled to $120 million. Operational metrics were exceptionally strong: API developer engagement rose 200%, Net Dollar Retention (NDR) stands at an industry-leading 140%, and the churn rate fell to just 1.2%.
